editorial:
Imagine Mickey Mouse as a wacky mad scientist in his lab, mixing up a magic potion that gives the little guy a big advantage. You get to watch a hilarious chain reaction where the underdog suddenly becomes the boss. It starts with a tiny fly fighting back against a spider, then moves to a mouse taking on a cat, and eventually leads to Pluto getting a taste of the power. The vibe is light, goofy, and full of the classic slapstick humor that makes these old shorts so much fun to watch with your family.

What really works here is the fast pacing and the way the jokes build on each other. You will love seeing the bullies get a taste of their own medicine. While it is a very short film, the animation is smooth and the timing is perfect. If you want the best experience, try finding a remastered version to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV to see those bright colors pop. It is a great pick for a quick laugh, and you might even want to add the Blu-ray to your physical collection for a movie night.
endingExplained: The chaos reaches a peak when Pegleg Pete tries to grab Pluto, but Pluto has been sprayed with the potion. Pluto turns the tables and beats Pete up in a funny fight. Eventually, the potion wears off or the cycle ends, leaving the bullies defeated and exhausted. It wraps up with a classic cartoon feel, showing that even the smallest creature can win if they have a little bit of magic on their side.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Disney shorts and slapstick comedy.
